strings: m_c doesn't know what's wrong. One day everything was bright, and beautiful, and now all {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/want/wants} to do is sleep. Oh, Starclan, just give {PRONOUN/m_c/object} a little more time to sleep.
While the frost comes and goes with the seasons, the frost on m_c's heart seems to have fogged up {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} mind.
m_c wants to move on with the seasons, but {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} just {VERB/m_c/seem/seems} to can't.
